description: Get spot-margin borrow rates per coin across Binance, OKX, Bybit and Gate.io (the venues that publish them without an account), for pricing a short spot leg (reverse cash-and-carry: sell spot, long perp) or a leveraged long. Each row is one coin with every venue's quote cheapest first: hourlyRate (fraction per hour) and annualRate (hourlyRate × 8,760, simple, fraction per year: 0.05 = 5%), the source endpoint and its time, plus lowest/highest venue. A venue that does not price a coin is absent, never 0; Gate.io covers its 100 most-traded loan currencies. `venues` says which venues answered (ok / stale / failed / unsupported). KuCoin, Bitget, MEXC, BingX and HTX publish no keyless rate. Filter with coin and exchanges.

exchanges.description: Comma-separated venues, case-insensitive: Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate.io (KuCoin, Bitget, MEXC, BingX and HTX are accepted and reported unsupported). Default: all.

name: get_arbitrage_borrow_rates

annualRate.description: hourlyRate × 8,760, simple (not compounded), a fraction (0.043 = 4.3% a year).

asOf.description: When the venue stamped the rate (Bybit's server time, Gate's rate hour), else when Sharpe fetched it (OKX, Binance).

hourlyRate.description: Interest per hour on the borrowed amount, a fraction (0.0000049 = 0.00049% an hour). A venue that publishes a daily rate is divided by 24.

amount.description: The most one account can borrow, in `unit`.

unit.description: `coin`: units of the borrowed asset (Bybit maxBorrowingAmount at No VIP, OKX quota for the Lv1 account, Binance borrowLimit at VIP 0). `usd`: USDT (Gate user_max_borrow_amount).

limit.description: The venue's per-account borrow limit for the coin at its entry tier: a cheap rate on a small limit cannot fund a large short. `null` when the venue publishes none (unknown, not unlimited).

source.description: The L0 endpoint contract the rate came from (bybit.spot-margin-data, okx.interest-rate-loan-quota, binance.margin-vip-spec, gate.unified-history-loan-rate).

rates.description: One quote per venue that prices the coin, cheapest first. A venue that does not price the coin is absent, never 0.

status.description: ok: fresh (≤ 5 minutes). stale: the last refresh failed and the last good answer (≤ 15 minutes old) is served. failed: nothing usable, the venue's coins are absent. unsupported: the venue publishes no keyless borrow rate.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Margin borrow rates
